title: Laplacian of an affinely rescaled C^2 function
statement: Let n in N, let h : R^n -> R be of class C^2, x0 in R^n and sigma in R. Then for every z in R^n, Laplacian(y -> h(x0 + sigma y))(z) = sigma^2 Laplacian(h)(x0 + sigma z), where Laplacian is Mathlib's Laplacian.laplacian.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Rn n → ℝ) (x₀ : Rn n) (σ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 h → ∀ z : Rn n, Laplacian.laplacian (fun y => h (x₀ + σ • y)) z = σ ^ 2 * Laplacian.laplacian h (x₀ + σ • z)
